data.body:
Landed at review. PR #4: https://github.com/mrojas54/tool-benchmarks/pull/4 (base main, head tb-6-probe -- based on #3/TB-3 parser, merge that first, this rebases cleanly since tb-6-probe == origin/tb-3-parse @ 77e91c4 plus this ticket's commit).

Delivered: toolbench/probe.py (PROBE_SPECS x5 over the vendored tools/ corpus, find_probe_calls sentinel+tool-name AND-verification, build_comparison_table with #8376 seed fallback, render_report/main writing to reports/ (gitignored, created at run time)), protocols/active-probes.md (5-path table), tests/test_probe.py + tests/fixtures/probe_session.jsonl (14 new tests: sentinel uniqueness/non-substring, both near-miss shapes, isolable-vs-non-isolable usage attribution, all-seeded fallback, real-tokens-when-matched, report rendering).

Validation green: ruff clean, mypy --strict clean (7 files), full suite 35/35 (14 new + 21 existing TB-3 tests).

Deviation (documented in plan + own-review, not filed against TB-3): find_probe_calls can't rely on ToolCall alone for sentinel verification since transcript.py's ToolCall intentionally normalizes tool input/output to char counts (result_len) and drops raw text. It does its own single-pass raw-JSONL scan for sentinel+tool-name matching, then still calls parse_session/ParseResult for the real token/usage numbers, joining by (ts, name). No changes made to transcript.py, sources.py, or passive.py.

PR #4 (tb-6-probe) merged to main as 1aaa206 at 2026-07-09T01:01:23Z. probe.py + active-probes.md landed. Verified on origin/main @4461c0e: ruff clean, mypy --strict clean (10 source files), 99 tests pass. Remote branch pruned post-merge.
